resources.name: Universal Modder
resources.summary: Agent-oriented toolkit for exploring and modding PC games, with workflows for reconnaissance, reverse engineering, asset work, and in-game testing.

resources.name: AI Game Modding Guides
resources.summary: Guides and templates for building game mods with AI coding agents, covering passthrough mods, rewrites, mod loaders, prompting, and troubleshooting.

resources.name: BepInEx
resources.summary: Unity/XNA game patcher and plugin framework. Stable v5 is in LTS (latest checked 5.4.23.5, 2026-02-08) and is the upstream-recommended line for Mono games; Unity IL2CPP uses a separate v6 bleeding-edge build stream (latest checked 6.0.0-be.788, 2026-09-01). Match runtime, OS, architecture, and game build; bleeding-edge builds can introduce bugs.

resources.name: MelonLoader
resources.summary: Unity mod loader supporting Mono and IL2CPP. Latest checked GitHub release v0.7.3 (2026-05-14) includes Unity 6000+ and Mono/IL2CPP Linux initialization fixes; match the target game, backend, platform, and architecture rather than assuming universal compatibility.

resources.name: UE4SS
resources.summary: Open-source Unreal Engine 4/5 runtime scripting/mod framework with Lua and C++ APIs, Blueprint mod loading, SDK generation, and inspection utilities. The latest stable release tag located is v3.0.1 (2024-02-14); the project also has an experimental channel. Current docs target UE 4.7–5.8 but explicitly say UE4SS is not plug-and-play; the documented install/build path is Windows/Win64 and title-specific configs/AOBs may be needed. Engine-version range is not a per-game or per-patch compatibility guarantee.

resources.name: REFramework
resources.summary: Capcom RE Engine runtime mod framework and scripting/plugin platform. Tagged v1.5.9.1 (2025-03-05) includes separate RE2, RE3, RE4, and Monster Hunter Rise assets; the project points to nightlies and remained active through 2026-09-16. RE2/RE3 non-ray-tracing branches use TDB-named packages. This is not a complete game-build compatibility matrix.

resources.name: UnityRuntimeExplorer
resources.summary: Live Unity runtime inspector for Mono and IL2CPP games, with MCP integration; check upstream for maturity and compatibility details.

resources.name: REA
resources.summary: Agent-oriented reverse-engineering project spanning application behavior through native binaries.

resources.name: Ghidra
resources.summary: Software reverse-engineering framework for disassembly, decompilation, scripting, and analysis of compiled code. Its v11.0.2 importer documentation lists Android APK and Dalvik DEX formats alongside native executable formats; its decompiler output is analysis/pseudocode, not original Java/Kotlin source.

resources.name: Ghidra MCP
resources.summary: MCP server that connects agent workflows to Ghidra, with GUI and headless analysis options.

resources.name: IDA MCP
resources.summary: The official Hex-Rays MCP server for IDA.

resources.name: radare2-mcp
resources.summary: Official radare2 MCP server for AI-agent-assisted binary analysis.

resources.name: Binary Ninja Headless MCP
resources.summary: Third-party headless bridge and CLI for Binary Ninja. Binary Ninja 6.0 provides a first-party GUI MCP server in GUI editions and a standalone headless server in Commercial/Ultimate editions on macOS/Linux; native Windows packages do not yet include the headless binary.

resources.name: Frida
resources.summary: Dynamic instrumentation toolkit for inspecting and tracing running processes; useful alongside static analysis for runtime research.

resources.name: ILSpy
resources.summary: Open-source.NET assembly browser and decompiler with desktop UI documented for Windows, Linux, and macOS. The project also includes ILSpyCmd, a command-line companion for automated decompilation, alongside features such as PDB generation, ReadyToRun, and metadata. Decompiled output is reconstructed, not original source.

resources.name: Cpp2IL
resources.summary: Work-in-progress tooling for reverse-engineering Unity's IL2CPP toolchain.

resources.name: Il2CppDumper
resources.summary: Restores IL2CPP metadata into dummy assemblies and generates analysis helpers for IDA, Ghidra, and Binary Ninja. GitHub showed its latest commit as 2024-07-06 when reviewed; current Unity-version support is not specified. Cpp2IL is a separate alternative.

resources.name: AssetRipper
resources.summary: GUI tool for analyzing Unity game files and converting assets into native Unity formats.

resources.name: UABEA
resources.summary: Cross-platform Unity asset-bundle and serialized-file reader/writer, geared toward modding and research; its README points to UABEANext as a newer work-in-progress version.

resources.name: unrpyc (Ren'Py script decompiler)
resources.summary: Decompiler for compiled Ren'Py.rpyc scripts; it does not extract.rpa archives and is not a runtime mod loader. Latest release located is v2.0.4 (2026-02-24); v2.x command-line use requires Python 3.9+ and supports Ren'Py 8.x down to 6.18.0 (older than 6.99.10 may need --no-init-offset). The separate legacy v1.x line uses Python 2.7 for Ren'Py 6/7. Upstream says not every engine release is actively tested

resources.name: rpa-toolkit
resources.summary: Small Python 3.12+ CLI for listing, extracting, creating, appending to, and deleting from Ren’Py RPA/RPI archives (RPA v1/v2/v3/v3.2), plus .rpyc/.rpymc decompilation. It is an archive/script utility, not a runtime mod loader. The repository reports code version 3.0.0 (2026-03-07), with no GitHub tags/releases and three commits visible at review; treat it as early-stage and validate on copies.

resources.name: FModel
resources.summary: CUE4Parse-based Unreal Engine archive explorer for previewing and exporting supported UE4/UE5 package assets. It is an asset/archive analysis tool, not a runtime mod loader or installer; parsing support varies with the game, engine version, and packaging format. Verify its current per-title support upstream.

resources.name: AnyPS5
resources.summary: A tool for porting PS5 executables to Linux and Windows.

resources.name: PortPS5
resources.summary: A project focused on porting decrypted PS5 game dumps to native Windows executables using binary relinking, replacement system libraries, and Vulkan.

resources.name: KytyPS5
resources.summary: Experimental PlayStation 5 emulator for Windows, Linux, and macOS; distinct from executable-porting projects.

resources.name: SharpEmu
resources.summary: Experimental PlayStation 5 emulator for Windows, Linux, and macOS; distinct from executable-porting projects.

resources.name: Claude Code
resources.summary: Anthropic's coding agent, available through terminal and editor/desktop surfaces; see the official docs for current access and provider requirements.

resources.name: Nigel
resources.summary: CLI orchestrator for iterative code-improvement tasks with coding agents such as Claude Code or Codex. It selects configured candidates, runs the agent and verification command, then commits successful tasks or resets failed ones.

resources.name: OpenAI Codex
resources.summary: OpenAI's terminal-based coding agent; consult the official repository for current setup and capabilities.

resources.name: OpenCode
resources.summary: Open-source coding agent for working with software projects; check upstream for supported providers and current features.

resources.name: Roo Code (archived reference)
resources.summary: Named by the AI Game Modding Guides; the upstream GitHub repository was archived on 2026-05-15. Historical project reference.

resources.name: SKSE
resources.summary: Skyrim Script Extender, which expands scripting and plugin capabilities. Builds are tied to particular game versions; verify the current runtime compatibility upstream.

resources.name: F4SE
resources.summary: Fallout 4 Script Extender for native plugins and expanded scripting. Match the release to the installed game runtime and check platform support upstream.

resources.name: Fabric Loader
resources.summary: Mod loader for Minecraft Java Edition; select a loader and mod set compatible with the target Minecraft version.

resources.name: Minecraft Forge
resources.summary: Minecraft modding framework and API; use versions and mods built for the same Minecraft/Forge release.

resources.name: NeoForge
resources.summary: Minecraft Java modding API based on Forge; check current game-version compatibility and choose mods for the same loader.

resources.name: Outer Wilds Mod Loader (OWML)
resources.summary: Outer Wilds-specific loader and framework. Release 2.16.3 was published 2026-09-06; its community project page says support is for the latest game version only (older builds are not guaranteed), with Echoes of the Eye and Epic, Steam, and Microsoft Store editions listed. OWML patches game code; use its uninstall/verify-file instructions.

resources.name: plugin-sdk
resources.category: Game-specific modding SDKs and development APIs
resources.summary: Developer SDK/source scaffolding for native ASI and CLEO plugins. The repository covers GTA2, GTA III, Vice City, San Andreas, and GTA IV, with separate Unreal-oriented directories for GTA III/VC/SA Definitive Edition; repository activity was visible through 2026-09-08. This is not a runtime installer or a compatibility certificate: match the exact executable, edition, architecture, and store build.

resources.name: UndertaleModTool
resources.summary: Active open-source GameMaker data-file editor/decompiler for Undertale, Deltarune, and other compatible titles. Latest stable v0.9.2.0 (2026-08-23): 64-bit Windows GUI; CLI builds for Windows, Ubuntu, and macOS, including native macOS ARM64. This release adds some GameMaker 2026.1 beta file/code-generation support and Deltarune Chapter 5 fixes, not a per-title compatibility guarantee. It edits files and GML VM code; YYC code editing is unsupported, and it is not a runtime loader.

resources.name: Ren'Py developer tools
resources.summary: Official docs for Ren'Py lint, console, script reload, and inspection; some functions require developer mode/config (for example, the console and script reload). These are authoring/debug features, not a player-side loader or universal packaged-game mod API.

resources.name: Mod Organizer 2
resources.summary: Mod manager for various PC games, especially useful in Bethesda-oriented workflows; it manages installations and profiles rather than replacing a game's mod loader.

resources.name: Vortex
resources.summary: Nexus Mods' general mod manager for installing and organizing supported game mods; it does not replace a game's loader or development API.

resources.name: r2modman
resources.summary: Mod manager for games distributed through Thunderstore; check the upstream project for current game and platform support.

resources.name: IDA Pro
resources.summary: Hex-Rays' commercial disassembler, decompiler, and debugger for interactive and automated binary analysis; the vendor offers a separate, more limited free edition.

resources.name: Binary Ninja
resources.summary: Extensible disassembler, decompiler, debugger, and binary-analysis platform. Binary Ninja 6.0 includes first-party MCP support; consult the official documentation for edition and platform differences. Binary Ninja Cloud is a separate hosted analysis service with its own feature set.

resources.name: Binary Ninja MCP Server
resources.summary: Official Binary Ninja MCP documentation. The GUI server is included with GUI editions; the standalone headless server has separate Commercial/Ultimate and operating-system requirements.

resources.name: SFSE
resources.summary: Starfield Script Extender for plugins and expanded scripting. Releases target specific Steam game runtimes and do not support the Windows Store/Game Pass edition.

resources.name: Outer Wilds Mod Manager
resources.summary: Outer Wilds mod manager with GUI, Core, and CLI release 0.15.7 (2026-07-13); OWML recommends it for installing the loader and mods. Windows, Linux/Steam Deck, and macOS guidance is documented with platform-specific caveats; match the current OWML/game version.

resources.name: GTA SA Open Downgrader
resources.summary: Open-source GTA San Andreas version-matching/downgrade and mod-installation utility. v0.2.3 (2026-09-19), the final 0.2.x release, documents NewSteam R2 Global and German inputs to v1.0 US (Hoodlum). It can identify other executable versions, but that does not mean a downgrade patch is available; a 0.3.x rewrite is planned.

resources.name: extract-xiso
resources.summary: Cross-platform command-line utility to create, list, rewrite, and extract Xbox XISO images.

resources.name: Velocity (Xbox 360 file manager)
resources.summary: Cross-platform Qt browser/editor for Xbox 360 files and packages, including STFS, FATX, XDBF, and disc/container formats. The latest visible upstream commit was October 2024 when checked; treat as a legacy option and verify compatibility.

resources.name: SkyCraft
resources.summary: Skyrim/Minecraft passthrough-mod example combining an SKSE plugin and a Fabric mod; its docs/DESIGN.md describes the system architecture.

resources.name: OWCraft
resources.summary: Outer Wilds/Minecraft passthrough example built around OWML and SkyCraft's shared-memory protocol, with design notes and a development log.

resources.name: IW4L
resources.summary: Experimental Call of Duty runtime/rewrite in Rust, Bevy, and wgpu; useful as a large rewrite case study, not a ready-to-use game mod.

resources.name: gang-beasts-rust
resources.summary: Rust/Bevy rewrite example with Python tools that read a player's own game files; the project demonstrates a whitelist.gitignore approach for keeping extracted data out of the repository.

resources.name: benilla
resources.summary: Large Rust/Bevy World of Warcraft 1.12.1 client rewrite with readers for game data formats.

resources.name: ELDEN RING Combat Rewrite
resources.summary: Rust/Bevy 0.19 study sandbox for Elden Ring player movement and combat, with action timings, root motion, animation data, and optional sounds derived from game files. Generated data is not committed; the README identifies estimated mechanics and omitted combat systems. It is a research/demo project, not a player-side mod or loader; no tested game-build/store matrix or GitHub release was listed on 2026-10-11.

resources.name: Faith Runner
resources.summary: Rust/Bevy Mirror's Edge movement and first-person animation sandbox with greybox courses and an engine-independent movement crate. It can load first-person assets, animations, and sounds from an installed Mirror's Edge, with a procedural-arm fallback, and includes UE3 readers and game-data research scripts, including Ghidra-based native-code analysis. It is a study/demo project, not a Mirror's Edge mod or loader; no tested game-build/store matrix or GitHub release was listed on 2026-10-11.

resources.name: OpenMW
resources.summary: Open-source Morrowind engine reimplementation; a mature, long-running project to study, not a general-purpose modding tool.

resources.name: OpenRCT2
resources.summary: Open-source reimplementation of RollerCoaster Tycoon 2; a long-running engine/game project rather than a mod loader or reverse-engineering tool.

resources.name: OpenTTD
resources.summary: Open-source transport simulation based on Transport Tycoon Deluxe; a mature reimplementation project rather than a mod loader or general-purpose tool.

resources.name: Game Decompilations Index
resources.summary: Community-maintained WIP directory of game decompilation/recompilation projects. Its README marks some entries as unfinished or unchecked; the directory is a discovery index.

resources.name: xNVSE
resources.summary: New Vegas Script Extender expands Fallout: New Vegas scripting for mods. Match the release to the game runtime and check upstream for supported storefronts and editions.

resources.name: MWSE
resources.summary: Morrowind Script Extender adds scripting and Construction Set extensions, including Lua support, for the original Morrowind; it is not compatible with OpenMW.

resources.name: xOBSE
resources.summary: Community-maintained Oblivion Script Extender fork that expands TES IV: Oblivion scripting; verify the target edition and runtime against current upstream guidance.

resources.name: FOSE (legacy)
resources.summary: Legacy Fallout 3 Script Extender. Its official page lists support for specific older retail, Steam, and GOG executable builds; newer executables are outside the listed matrix.

resources.name: SMAPI
resources.summary: Open-source Stardew Valley mod loader and API for code mods, with compatibility and troubleshooting support; check the current game-version and platform guidance upstream.

resources.name: tModLoader
resources.summary: Framework for creating and playing Terraria mods; the upstream branch tracks Terraria 1.4.5, so pair the loader, game, and mods by compatible version.

resources.name: Godot Mod Loader
resources.summary: General-purpose GDScript mod-loader framework with ZIP mods, load order, dependencies, configuration, and local/Steam Workshop/Thunderstore sources. It is not a universal drop-in for arbitrary Godot games: game-specific integration/setup is required. Latest tags located: Godot 3.x v6.3.0 (branch docs say Godot 3.5+), Godot 4.x v7.0.1 (Godot 4.1–4.3; integration-targeted, with self-setup still being improved). The active 4.x-dev README (updated 2026-08-21) lists nine games, including Brotato, Dome Keeper, and Windowkill; that is not a release/build/platform matrix. Mods are not sandboxed.

resources.name: Everest
resources.summary: Celeste mod loader and base API; consult the project website and wiki for installation, supported builds, and mod-development guidance.

resources.name: me3
resources.summary: FromSoftware runtime mod framework and mod-profile launcher; upstream lists Dark Souls III, Sekiro, and Elden Ring among its targets and calls it the successor to Mod Engine 2. Latest release located: v0.13.0 (2026-08-11). Official docs list Windows, Linux/Steam Deck via Proton, and macOS via CrossOver; exact game-build and per-mod support remains specific.

resources.name: Mod Engine 2 (archived reference)
resources.summary: Historical FromSoftware mod loader, archived by its upstream on 2024-07-19 with development discontinued. Smithbox's current README retains it for DS1/DS2 and pre-1.15.2 DS3 or other legacy workflows; me3 is the successor for most modern-game mod launches. Old mod/config compatibility with me3 is not implied.

resources.name: Godot RE Tools
resources.summary: Godot project-recovery and reverse-engineering toolkit for PCK/APK/EXE inputs, including archive extraction, GDScript decompilation, and resource conversion; it is not a runtime mod loader. Upstream documents Godot 2.x/3.x/4.x support; latest release located is v2.7.0 (2026-10-03). Results depend on the exact build format, bytecode, and encryption/build settings; recovered project-like output is not original source.

resources.name: Source 2 Viewer
resources.summary: Viewer, parser, exporter, and command-line decompiler for Valve Source 2 resources, including VPK archives, maps, models, materials, textures, and sounds; consult the format-support reference for limitations and data loss. This is an asset-analysis utility, not a player-side mod loader or manager.

resources.name: WolvenKit (Cyberpunk 2077)
resources.summary: Community mod editor and asset toolkit for Cyberpunk 2077 / REDengine 4; check the project's current releases and game-version compatibility before use.

resources.name: WolvenKit (The Witcher 3)
resources.summary: WolvenKit's separate repository for The Witcher 3 / REDengine 3; it is distinct from the current Cyberpunk 2077 repository, so verify the appropriate release and compatibility notes.

resources.name: CodeWalker
resources.summary: Community GTA V RPF archive explorer and world/map research/editor tool, not a runtime loader. The upstream README targets the PC game and Windows x64 and describes the project as WIP with incomplete/crash-prone areas. The latest visible repository commit was 2025-04-11; no current Legacy-versus-Enhanced or store/build matrix is stated.

resources.name: Crowbar (GoldSrc / Source)
resources.summary: Author-designated landing page for Crowbar, a GoldSrc/Source modding utility for model compilation and decompilation and related asset workflows. The upstream source repository says to link this page for current information; its latest visible source release was version 0.74 in 2023, so verify current compatibility.

resources.name: Source SDK 2013
resources.summary: Valve's public Source SDK game code for Half-Life 2, HL2:DM, and Team Fortress 2; it is not the complete Source engine and does not include Portal 2's game code. The default/master line is multiplayer/TF2-oriented; the distinct `singleplayer` branch supplies HL2-era SP code but, per current documentation, lacks the 20th Anniversary changes. Master-branch repository activity was visible through 2026-09-05. Match the SDK Base/branch to the target runtime; no named mod was build-tested.

resources.name: Blockbench
resources.summary: Open-source low-poly 3D modeling, texturing, and animation editor with plugins and game-oriented export formats; widely used for Minecraft-style and other game assets. It is an asset-authoring tool, not a loader.

resources.name: bridge. (Minecraft Bedrock)
resources.summary: Current bridge. v2 editor for Minecraft Bedrock add-ons, including behavior/resource-pack authoring; this is the next-generation editor repository, distinct from the legacy v1 repository.

resources.name: Frosty Tool Suite (stable v1 line)
resources.summary: Community release fork of Frosty Tool Suite 1.0.6.3 for selected DICE Frostbite games. The repository's visible code activity ended in 2023; game profiles, plugins, and executable compatibility vary, so treat it as a maintenance-sensitive legacy line and verify the exact game.

resources.name: Frosty Tool Suite rewrite (WIP)
resources.summary: The Frosty organization’s.NET 8 rewrite is explicitly early-development, has no functional UI or release, and is not a drop-in replacement for the stable v1 line; upstream points to the older release repository.

resources.name: Quilt Loader
resources.summary: Open-source mod loader for Minecraft Java Edition; check the Quilt project's current game-version and mod-compatibility guidance rather than assuming Fabric compatibility.

resources.name: Minecraft Bedrock Creator Tools (Microsoft docs)
resources.summary: Microsoft's creator-documentation directory describing third-party Bedrock/Java world, model, particle, and server tools. The page explicitly notes that listed tools are external contributors, not Microsoft offerings; verify each tool independently.

resources.name: Chunker
resources.summary: Open-source world conversion tool for Minecraft Java and Bedrock Edition; consult its documented version support and conversion limitations before moving a world.

resources.name: Amulet Minecraft World Editor
resources.summary: Minecraft world editor and converter for supported Java/Bedrock formats, with block editing, chunk operations, structure import/export, and Python operations. Current versions are paid; the project site links the last free version and purchase channels.

resources.name: RPG Maker MZ Core API Documentation
resources.summary: Official API documentation for RPG Maker MZ projects and JavaScript plugin authors; applies to project/plugin development, not a general unpacker for packaged games.

resources.name: RPG Maker MV/MZ Official Plugin Guides
resources.summary: Official beginner guide series for installing and authoring RPG Maker MV/MZ JavaScript plugins; the linked article points to Part 2. Plugin compatibility depends on engine generation and project version.

resources.name: GZDoom
resources.summary: Doom-engine source port with scripting and mod support. The latest GZDoom tag located is g4.14.2 (2025-05-03); the official ZDoom downloads page now identifies UZDoom as the primary port and GZDoom as historical. Check each port's supported game data, archive formats, and script versions; neither is a universal id Tech loader.

resources.name: id Software Source Releases
resources.summary: Official GitHub organization with separate source-code releases for classic DOOM, Quake, Quake II, Quake III Arena, DOOM 3, and DOOM 3 BFG, plus separate Quake II tool and rerelease-code repositories. These are code/reference sources, not a common player-side loader; included assets vary.

resources.name: AnvilToolkit
resources.summary: Author-distributed toolkit for editing files from selected Ubisoft Anvil games. Version 1.3.7 was updated 2026-09-09. The author's supported-title list spans Assassin's Creed (from AC1 through Shadows, including Black Flag Resynced), Ghost Recon Breakpoint, and Steep; features vary by title/build.

resources.name: FractureLoader
resources.summary: Game-specific mod loader and runtime tools for South Park: The Fractured But Whole, a Snowdrop-engine title; the public repository lists v1.1.0 from 2026-02-23. Treat it as title-specific, not a general Snowdrop SDK.

resources.name: Universal Snowdrop Modloader (archived reference)
resources.summary: Archived Snowdrop loader repository (archived 2025-12-31) whose documentation names Star Wars Outlaws and Avatar: Frontiers of Pandora. The maintainer separately offers Raindrop; compatibility of older mods and requirements with that loader is undocumented.

resources.name: Nexus Mods Submission Guidelines
resources.summary: Official Nexus Mods file-submission and moderation guidance for publishing projects.

resources.name: Steam Workshop (Steamworks documentation)
resources.summary: Valve's official Steamworks guide for integrating Workshop item creation, upload, and visibility into a game/tool. Requires a participating game's Steamworks configuration; it is not a universal player-side mod installer.

resources.name: Thunderstore
resources.summary: Community mod database organized by game communities, with a related mod manager. Package formats, game support, publishing rules, and loader dependencies vary by community; consult the target game's current publishing documentation.

resources.name: CurseForge Project Publishing Guide
resources.summary: Official CurseForge author guidance for creating a project and submitting files for moderation; supported games, file types, and release channels vary by title.

resources.name: mod.io UGC Documentation
resources.summary: Official developer documentation for integrating mod.io UGC through Unity/Unreal plugins, a C++ SDK, or the REST API. Console/mobile UGC uses game-specific integrations; this path does not add mod support to arbitrary retail games.

resources.name: RPG Maker MV/MZ Official Plugin Guide — Part 2
resources.summary: Part 2 of the official MV/MZ JavaScript plugin guide, covering plugin commands and notetags; check engine-generation and project-version compatibility.

resources.name: RPG Maker VX/VX Ace Official Tutorials
resources.summary: Official legacy tutorials for RPG Maker VX and VX Ace, including editor workflows and a VX Ace script-editor tutorial. This is authoring guidance, not a tool for inspecting packaged games.

resources.name: RGSS Database CLI
resources.summary: Community Ruby CLI for development-only export/import of RPG Maker XP/VX/VX Ace project database files as JSON or YAML for version control. The latest listed release is 1.0.4 from 2025-03-14; requires Ruby 3+ and is not an encrypted-archive extractor.

resources.name: Ren'Py Translation Documentation
resources.summary: Official translation authoring workflow for dialogue, interface strings, images/files, and styles when project scripts are available. Upstream says its focus is sanctioned translations using creator-supplied scripts/templates and that unsanctioned support is more limited; this is not a general player-side mod path.

resources.name: Ren'Py 8.5.3 (official SDK release)
resources.summary: Official release page for Ren'Py 8.5.3 (released 2026-05-15; latest stable located on 2026-10-06). The SDK is an authoring toolkit for Windows, macOS, and Linux, not a universal player-side mod loader. Match the target project's Ren'Py/Python generation and exact game build.

resources.name: DDLC Mod Template 2.0 (community, v5.1.0)
resources.summary: Unofficial community template for mods of the original DDLC PC game; the project says it is not affiliated with Team Salvato and is not designed for DDLC Plus. v5.1.0 (2026-10-06) provides separate Py3/Ren'Py 8 and Py2/Ren'Py 7 packages; the author marks the Py2 line final except for bug fixes. Android build support was re-added; compatibility with the separate official mobile app is unverified.

resources.name: Half-Life 1 SDK (GoldSrc game code)
resources.summary: Valve's Half-Life 1 engine-based game SDK/source repository, updated for the October 2024 Steam patch. It provides game code for mod development, not the complete GoldSrc engine source.

resources.name: Counter-Strike Workshop — Official Guides and Resources
resources.summary: Official Counter-Strike workshop portal with resources for maps, weapon finishes, stickers, and content submission; scope is the supported Workshop workflow, not unrestricted runtime modification.

resources.name: Counter-Strike 2 Workshop Tools Documentation
resources.summary: Valve Developer Community documentation describing the official CS2 Workshop Tools and their map, model, material, scripting, and publishing workflows. The wiki is community-maintained; the software is provided by Valve with CS2.

resources.name: ARK: Survival Ascended DevKit Documentation
resources.summary: Official Studio Wildcard documentation for the UE5-based ARK: Survival Ascended DevKit. ASA mods are plugin-based; the UGC workflow uses cloud cooking and lets creators select PC-only or cross-platform output. The docs distinguish Windows/WindowsServer packages from Xbox Series X|S and PS5 packages, which require platform review/certification. This is a title-specific authoring/publishing kit, not a general Unreal mod API.

resources.name: Smithbox
resources.summary: FromSoftware editing suite for Elden Ring, Nightreign, Armored Core VI, Sekiro, Dark Souls III and other listed Souls titles; includes map/model/parameter/text/GPARAM/material/texture and file-browser editors, but is not a runtime loader. Release 2.2.6 (2026-09-20) updates Param Upgrader data for ER regulation 1.17.1 and includes an HKS reloader feature for ER/DS3 1.15.0; these are feature-specific boundaries, not a blanket current-build matrix. Editors do not require unpacking; upstream recommends me3 for most modern-game launches.

resources.name: MonoMod
resources.summary: Actively developed MIT-licensed.NET modding basework with IL patching and runtime detours/hooks; useful to compatible Mono/.NET/XNA/FNA games but not a plug-and-play loader for every game.

resources.name: OpenIV
resources.summary: Official Windows RAGE archive/resource editor for GTA V, GTA IV, and Max Payne 3; the site lists OpenIV 4.1 (announced 2022-01-18 as a return after a development pause). The 4.1 note says it does not include RDR2 editing; 4.0.1 had only basic RDR2 support, with no editing functionality. OpenIV.asi is a separate Legacy-era loading component, not the archive editor itself; no current GTA V Enhanced support is established.

resources.name: Lenny's Mod Loader (RDR2)
resources.summary: RDR2-specific virtual-file-system loader for replacing supported game files/assets. The page lists Beta 11 build 0.6.8470.31280, released 2023-03-31; no newer release was observed. No current RDR2 build/store matrix is published there, so treat it as maintenance-sensitive and check each mod and prerequisite.

resources.name: Script Hook RDR2 (AB Software Development)
resources.summary: Official native-function library for RDR2 ASI plugins. The page lists v1.0.1491.17 (2023-02-09), supported patches 1.0.1207.58/1491.17 and above, and includes an ASI loader plus Native Trainer. It explicitly says it does not work in Red Dead Online and closes the game on multiplayer entry; the upstream patch range is not an individual-mod/store compatibility test.

resources.name: Script Hook V
resources.summary: Official GTA V native-function/ASI runtime. The developer page lists v3889.0/1158.13 (2026-07-15), for Legacy executable 1.0.3889.0 and Enhanced 1.0.1158.13; it closes the game on GTA Online entry. Recheck exact executable/store build.

resources.summary: Official .NET plugin framework and developer console for GTA V and RDR2. These releases are older than current game builds; the pages select GTA V Legacy, not Enhanced.

resources.name: Gibbed's Dunia Tools
resources.summary: Open-source tools and code for Dunia-engine games in the Far Cry series. Last repository activity observed was 2021; treat as legacy research tooling and verify game/version and archive-format support before use.

resources.name: Gibbed's Disrupt Tools
resources.summary: Experimental open-source tools for Disrupt-based Watch Dogs games. Upstream says the project is experimental and its TODO is 'Everything'; the last visible repository activity was 2020, so historical/WIP only.

resources.name: Crysis Mod SDK v1.2 Release Notes (legacy)
resources.summary: Crytek's official 2008 announcement/documentation pointer for the original Crysis Mod SDK v1.2/Sandbox2. Historical original-Crysis scope, separate from current CRYENGINE development tools and any Crysis Remastered kit.

resources.name: idStudio and DOOM Eternal Mods (official docs)
resources.summary: Official id Software documentation for DOOM Eternal's PC Mods launcher and idStudio creator beta. The official FAQ lists Steam PC and Microsoft Store PC for the launcher/mods, but describes the Microsoft Store route as an Xbox Insider PC Mod Preview; Bethesda Support describes access as Steam Beta or Xbox Insider. idStudio itself is Steam-PC-only. Treat access as branch/preview-gated and recheck the exact store/build; this is one title-specific path, not a general id Tech 7 toolchain.

resources.name: Atlan Modding Tools (DOOM: The Dark Ages)
resources.summary: Community runtime loader for DOOM: The Dark Ages. The latest public loader release located is Version 9 (2025-08-17), supporting game logic, level/map-entity, audio, texture, font, and related resource manipulation; it officially supports Steam only. The loader ZIP includes a separate GUI manager. Source activity was visible through 2026-09-11, but no newer tagged loader release was located and current game-patch/binary compatibility remains unverified. Authoring/extraction tools are separate resources.

resources.name: DOOM: The Dark Ages Modding Wiki (community reference)
resources.summary: Community documentation with DOOM: The Dark Ages-specific guidance for Atlan tools, level/entity, audio, texture, and font mods. It is not id Software documentation or evidence of official support; check linked tools and game-version details independently.

resources.name: UE Modding Tools Databank (discovery index)
resources.summary: Community directory of tools and guides with potential cross-game Unreal Engine use; last repository update observed 2026-08-08. Its README identifies some entries as unmaintained or outdated; it is a discovery index.

resources.name: Satisfactory Mod Loader (SML)
resources.summary: Unofficial, title-specific loader/framework for Satisfactory. Latest listed PC loader release v3.12.0 (2026-06-06) names Satisfactory 1.2 build CL#491125; the latest game patch located is 1.2.4.0 / CL#502094 (2026-08-11). Later repository activity is not a released compatibility declaration for that build, so verify current release and individual mod support rather than assuming parity.

resources.name: Satisfactory Modding Documentation
resources.summary: Maintained community documentation for Satisfactory users and developers, covering SML, Satisfactory Mod Manager, Alpakit packaging, Blueprint/C++ and ContentLib workflows, and mod uploads. It is game-specific and versioned; the page reports 1,200+ mods in the repository.

resources.name: Satisfactory Mod Manager
resources.summary: Community manager recommended by the Satisfactory modding docs for installing mods, dependencies, and SML from the Satisfactory Mod Repository. Latest checked release v3.1.0 (2026-06-06) provides Windows, Linux, and macOS downloads. It manages mod packages but does not prove the SML release or any individual mod supports the current Satisfactory game build.

resources.name: Satisfactory Mod Repository (SMR / FICSIT.app)
resources.summary: Title-specific Satisfactory UGC repository linked from the community modding documentation and integrated with Satisfactory Mod Manager. It is a game community service, not a general mod API or engine-level tool.

resources.name: Rayman Control Panel
resources.summary: Active community launcher/modding environment for selected Rayman games, with a mod loader, GameBanana integration, and an archive explorer for supported.dat, CPA.cnt, and UbiArt.ipk files. Latest fetched release was 14.5.0 (2026-04-13); repository activity continued through 2026-07-10. Native app is Windows-only; Wine/Proton use is not fully verified.

resources.name: UbiArt Archive Tools (archived)
resources.summary: Python IPK packer/unpacker whose README lists Rayman Origins/Legends, Just Dance 2014–2022 (with gaps/ambiguous year wording), and Child of Light. The repository was archived 2026-05-11 and its last commit was 2023-11-09; no releases are published. Treat as legacy and verify each title/configuration.

resources.name: ubiart-secure-fat (legacy UbiArt utility)
resources.summary: Small Python utility that generates a UbiArt secure_fat.gf file index used by listed Just Dance and Rayman games when adding custom file paths. The last visible repository commit was 2022-08-28; its broader compatibility claim is unverified. Treat as a legacy, title-specific helper, not an archive editor or general UbiArt SDK.

resources.name: ubi-canvas Δ (WIP reference)
resources.summary: Work-in-progress UbiArt level viewer/editor; last code activity observed 2026-07-06. The maintainer describes the public delta repository as temporary and incomplete; the main project is private. Title support ranges from limited viewing to editing.

resources.name: Ghost Recon Breakpoint Modding Knowledgebase
resources.summary: Living community research project for Ghost Recon: Breakpoint Anvil/Scimitar.forge files, Anvil Toolkit, and asset replacement. The repository explicitly separates verified from inferred claims and tracks open questions; last visible commit was 2026-10-04. It is a discovery/reference source, not a tool or independent verification.

resources.name: Hunter (Snowdrop asset extractor)
resources.summary: Maintainer-hosted Windows x64 extractor v2.29, page dated 2026-09-16, for The Division, The Division 2, Avatar: Frontiers of Pandora, XDefiant, and Star Wars Outlaws. It exports selected textures, models, animations, sounds, and raw files; it is not a gameplay mod loader.

resources.name: Raindrop (Avatar / Star Wars Outlaws loader)
resources.summary: Maintainer-hosted loose-file mod loader v1.04, page dated 2026-09-20, for Avatar: Frontiers of Pandora and Star Wars Outlaws. The page lists Windows 10+ as officially supported and only reports Wine success from some users; it provides no warranty. Check the exact game build and mod requirements.

resources.name: Far Cry Modding Guide (community reference)
resources.summary: Community guide for selected Dunia-era Far Cry PC games. It documents per-title Mod Installer workflows for Far Cry 3, 4, Primal, 5, New Dawn, and 6, and says Far Cry 1, 2, and Blood Dragon are not covered by those installers. Match the original PC game/store version and package to the guide; this is not an Ubisoft SDK.

resources.name: Far Cry Mod Installer download hub
resources.summary: Community-operated download hub for separate Far Cry Mod Installers and mod packs. The Far Cry 6 page showed installer build v20250412-1300 dated 2025-04-12; supported games and installer versions differ. The linked guide lists title/store boundaries; the hub does not represent a universal Dunia installer.

resources.name: RageOpenRDR2
resources.summary: Community ASI-based RDR2 modified-RPF loading project, first public v1.0 released 2026-05-09. It requires a separate ASI loader; its README says editing RPFs requires CodeX (early access) and describes its alternate loading route as WIP. Compatibility with official RDR2 Title Update 1.32 / the community-listed 1491.50 executable was not established.

resources.name: RageOpenV
resources.summary: Community ASI alternative to OpenIV.asi for GTA V Legacy and OpenRPF.asi for Enhanced, loading modified RPFs from a mods folder. Public v1.0 (2026-05-09) is the first release and needs a separate ASI loader. No complete edition/build matrix or cross-edition asset conversion is documented.

resources.name: ScriptHookVDotNet Enhanced
resources.summary: Community.NET scripting bridge for GTA V Legacy and Enhanced. v1.1.0.6 (2026-07-15) explicitly addresses Enhanced executable 1.0.1158.13; the release is labelled Legacy + Enhanced but does not give a newer Legacy executable/store matrix. Rockstar Title Update 1.73 notes postdate this release without mapping their activity to executable builds, so recheck current support.

resources.name: mod.io REST API Documentation
resources.summary: Official REST API reference for developers integrating mod.io UGC. The docs identify web apps needing JSON APIs and game developers building custom integrations as use cases; Unreal/Unity plugins and a C++ SDK are also listed. It is not a generic way to mod arbitrary browser, mobile, or retail games.

resources.name: Blacksmith (legacy Ubisoft asset viewer)
resources.summary: Legacy community viewer/extractor/converter for textures, models, and sounds from Assassin’s Creed Origins/Odyssey/Valhalla and Steep. The author explicitly says it cannot modify, inject, or replace game files. Latest listed release is 1.9.5.1 (2021-09-17); source repository activity last visible 2022-11-01, and source for later versions is not published there.

resources.name: Crysis 2 Mod SDK announcement (historical)
resources.summary: Crytek’s official 2011 announcement for the Crysis 2 Mod SDK and Sandbox 3 Editor, which supported custom maps, mods, and content. The announcement points to the then-current MyCrysis/Crymod download sites; current official binary availability and present-day OS compatibility were not verified.

resources.name: Crysis Creative Tools Mod
resources.summary: Community gameplay/creative mod with entity-spawning tools for original Crysis, Crysis Warhead, and a separate Crysis 1 Remastered variant. Latest tagged release is v1.2 (2024-03-03); repository activity continued through 2025-04-12. This is a limited mod, not an official SDK; match the tested GOG/Steam builds listed upstream.

resources.name: Crysis 2 Remastered Mod SDK Tutorial (community guide)
resources.summary: User-authored guide uploaded 2026-07-07 describing a level-editing workflow that uses the Crysis 2 Maximum Edition Mod SDK and then adapts level files for Crysis 2 Remastered. It is an experimental community procedure, not an official Remastered SDK or independently tested workflow; read the original game/SDK and file-version caveats first.

resources.name: OpenRPF (GTA V Enhanced)
resources.summary: Community GTA V Enhanced/Gen9 mods-folder RPF loader; the author page lists v0.3 (2025-12-18) and a bundled proxy/ASI-loading component. Notes cite compatibility from game build 1013.17+ and report that Legacy/Gen8 files can crash Enhanced. No mapping to later Rockstar Title Update 1.73 executable builds is published; this is separate from RageOpenV.

resources.name: Unity Manual: scripting back ends
resources.summary: Official Unity Manual explaining Mono JIT versus IL2CPP AOT and the platform-specific backend choice. A Unity engine label alone does not identify the runtime used by a shipped game or store build.

resources.name: BepInEx runtime-selection and installation guide
resources.summary: Upstream BepInEx guide separates Unity Mono and IL2CPP binaries and gives common install-folder clues (Managed versus il2cpp_data). The master documentation labels itself unreleased; match the current stable or bleeding-edge channel, game architecture, OS, and game build.

resources.name: RimWorld Modding Tutorials (community wiki)
resources.summary: Community-maintained RimWorld mod-authoring hub covering XML/Defs, PatchOperations, C# assemblies, testing, and version migration. The wiki says RimWorld has no formal modding API and that this material is community-maintained; it is not official Ludeon documentation.

resources.name: RimWorld 1.6.4850 release notes (Ludeon)
resources.summary: Official Ludeon release notes for RimWorld 1.6.4850 (2026-06-08). The post says that update should be compatible with saves and mods; this is not a per-mod or per-DLC compatibility matrix.

resources.name: OWML project page (community listing)
resources.summary: Community mod-directory page for Outer Wilds Mod Loader with installation, current compatibility, and store-edition notes. The directory states it is not affiliated with Mobius Digital; use the linked OWML source for code and release provenance.

resources.name: Valheim 1.0 FAQ (official)
resources.summary: Official Iron Gate FAQ says Valheim has no official mod support, 1.0 mod compatibility is not guaranteed, consoles have no mod support, and Steam Workshop will not be featured. It also lists the 1.0 storefront/platform editions; none of that establishes compatibility for a community loader.

resources.name: Risk of Rain 2 official announcements
resources.summary: Official game announcement feed. At the 2026-10-06 review, Alloyed Collective patch 1.4.1 (2025-12-09) was the latest released numbered PC update found, while an October 2026 Hallowed Concepts post still described a future patch; recheck before asserting mod compatibility.

resources.name: Harmony Mod for RimWorld
resources.summary: Shared Harmony patch library packaged as a RimWorld mod. Release 2.4.2.0 (2025-09-03) loads Harmony into the game; upstream says to load it first. It is a shared patch dependency, not a standalone game loader.

resources.name: HugsLib (RimWorld)
resources.summary: Shared RimWorld mod library; release 12.0.0 (2025-07-13) updates to RimWorld 1.6. Install it when a mod declares the dependency and follow that mod’s load-order and version requirements.

resources.name: RimSort
resources.summary: Open-source RimWorld mod manager with Windows, macOS, and Linux support. Latest checked stable release v1.15.0 was published 2026-10-04; a manager organizes installs and load order but does not guarantee mod compatibility.

resources.name: RimPy (legacy manager)
resources.summary: RimWorld manager with no recent release observed: v1.2.6.29 was Linux-only (2022-11-20) and Windows v1.2.6.28 dates to 2022-10-31. It is a legacy, maintenance-sensitive option; RimWorld 1.6 support is not established.

resources.name: BepInExPack for Valheim
resources.summary: Community-configured BepInEx 5.4.23.5 pack for Valheim; Thunderstore listing v5.4.2351 was updated around 2026-09-22. Includes Linux game/server scripts and macOS Rosetta instructions. The package does not publish a supported Valheim-build matrix; individual-plugin compatibility after 1.0 is unverified.

resources.name: CKAN (Kerbal Space Program mod manager)
resources.summary: Community mod manager/catalog for Kerbal Space Program; KSP1 is the target of this audit. Latest checked release v1.36.4 was published 2026-05-12. CKAN is an installer and dependency/version manager, not a game mod API; verify the selected game instance and mod metadata.

resources.name: ModuleManager (KSP1)
resources.summary: KSP config-patching mod that applies declarative changes to game and other-mod configuration at load time. The latest successful canonical Jenkins artifact located was build #163 / v4.2.3 (2023-07-03); KSP Community Fixes explicitly lists this ModuleManager dependency. Workflow commits do not identify a newer compiled release.

resources.name: ModuleManager /L fork (KSP1)
resources.summary: Separate ModuleManager fork with release 4.2.3.7 (2026-03-29) for KSP 1.2.2 and later; it requires KSPe 2.5 or higher. The two forks can conflict when installed together. KSP Community Fixes names the canonical dependency and does not confirm this fork as a substitute.

resources.name: KSP Community Fixes
resources.summary: KSP1 C# plugin collecting community bug fixes, performance patches, and small quality-of-life changes. Its README supports KSP 1.8.0–1.12.5, recommends 1.12.5, and requires HarmonyKSP plus canonical ModuleManager; CKAN installation is recommended. Source activity was visible through 2026-09-09.

resources.name: RoR2BepInExPack (Risk of Rain 2)
resources.summary: Risk of Rain 2-specific BepInEx ecosystem pack; latest Thunderstore listing was v1.43.0 (reviewed 2026-10-06). Its changelog says v1.35.0 added game-asset paths for DLC3; current post-patch support is not specified.

resources.name: R2API Core (Risk of Rain 2)
resources.summary: Core module of the modular R2API project; Thunderstore lists v5.3.0, whose changelog says it fixes the Risk of Rain 2 1.4.1 update. The core is a dependency for other API modules, not the full feature set; additional submodules are listed separately.

resources.name: UE4SS Documentation
resources.summary: Official documentation for UE4SS Lua/C++ scripting, Blueprint mod loading, SDK generation, installation, and compatibility troubleshooting. It says UE4SS is not plug-and-play for every game, may require title-specific AOB/config work, and documents a Windows/Win64 installation path; its listed UE version range is not a guarantee for every game build.

resources.name: Hogwarts Legacy Creator Kit (Epic Games Store)
resources.summary: Official free, Windows-only Avalanche Software creator tool for Hogwarts Legacy, released 2025-01-30 through the Epic Games Store. Supports title-specific content such as characters, cosmetics, dungeons, and quests; this is a game-specific editor/toolchain, not a general Unreal Engine mod API or runtime loader.

resources.name: Hogwarts Legacy Mods - Player FAQ (official)
resources.summary: Official player guide: supported mod editions are PC Steam and Epic Games Store, accessed through the in-game Mods browser with a linked Warner Bros. Games account. Mods apply to separate Mod Saves; achievements are disabled on Mod Enabled saves. Console mod support is not included.

resources.name: Hogwarts Legacy Mods - Authors FAQ (official)
resources.summary: Official creator FAQ. The Creator Kit is free through Epic Games Store; creators need Warner Bros. Games, Epic Games, and CurseForge account links to author/upload through the official flow. Official player mods are for Steam/Epic PC, not console; the game-specific Creator Kit is not a universal Unreal tool.

resources.name: Hogwarts Legacy Creator Kit System Requirements (official)
resources.summary: Official Creator Kit requirements page: Windows 10 and Epic login; English-only support/upload flow; lists 32 GB RAM and 450 GB SSD minimum, with 64 GB RAM and 600 GB SSD recommended. These are Creator Kit requirements, not the base game requirements.

resources.name: Hogwarts Legacy PC Hotfix - 2025-12-03 (official)
resources.summary: Official PC hotfix page dated 2025-12-03; lists build 1613387 for Steam/Epic Games Store and 1614419 for Windows PC. The change fixes a mod-browser issue with more than 20 favorites/uploads. This was the latest official PC build note located at the 2026-10-06 review, not a guarantee for every Creator Kit/mod combination.

resources.name: Palworld - About MODs and 1.0 (official)
resources.summary: Pocketpair’s official pre-1.0 notice says the 1.0 systems overhaul can make previously installed mods cause issues; remove older mod files before updating, then check each mod’s 1.0 compatibility and test individually. The statement welcomes modding but does not guarantee that a loader or mod works on a given game build.

resources.name: Palworld official announcements and patch feed
resources.summary: Official Steam announcement feed. At the 2026-10-06 review, v1.0.5 (2026-09-14) was the latest numbered game update found; the July 2026 v1.0.2 PC update announced mod-stability changes. The official Workshop is a Steam-client path; other stores/consoles are not implied. A patch announcement does not certify every Workshop, UE4SS, PalSchema, or other mod build.

resources.name: Installing Mods on a Palworld Server (official guide)
resources.summary: Official dedicated-server mod guide, labeled docs version 1.0.4 at review. It documents Workshop/PalModSettings.ini deployment and Windows dedicated-server limits, and notes potential save corruption or crashes with mods. The guide predates the later 1.0.5 game patch and does not give a client/store compatibility matrix.

resources.name: RE-UE4SS Palworld-specific fork (Okaetsu)
resources.summary: Unofficial Palworld-specific fork of the UE4SS experimental runtime, created for engine edits introduced in Palworld 0.4.1.5. Latest Palworld-specific tag located was 2281fa31 (2026-09-03), before game v1.0.5; current patch compatibility is unverified. Upstream reports a double-load crash when this fork is loaded alongside the separate Steam Workshop UE4SS item.

resources.name: PalSchema (Palworld)
resources.summary: Community Palworld data/modding framework that works with the Palworld-specific UE4SS line. Latest release located was v0.6.71 (2026-09-09), before Palworld v1.0.5; check the release notes for its required UE4SS commit and exact game compatibility. It is not an official Pocketpair API or a blanket guarantee for Workshop/server mods.

resources.name: Satisfactory official patch notes feed
resources.summary: Official Coffee Stain patch-note feed. Latest released game patch located at review was Satisfactory v1.2.4.0 / build CL#502094 (2026-08-11), across the base game’s supported platforms. A cross-platform game update is not evidence of SML/mod support on consoles or proof that a PC mod loader release supports this exact build.

resources.name: YYToolkit
resources.summary: Runtime plugin/mod framework for GameMaker games on Windows 8.1–11, with runtime loading/unloading and hooks into GameMaker functions. Its Legacy/Next compatibility table is runtime/architecture-specific: Legacy lists GM 1.4–2022, while Next lists GM 2.x–2024 beta; neither certifies a game/build. Latest stable release located is v4.0.1 (2025-03-13); v5.0.0c (2026-03-03) is explicitly an unstable test beta that breaks v4 plugins. Newer GM 2026/GMRT support is not declared.

resources.name: G3M (GameMaker Mod Manager)
resources.summary: Desktop mod manager with GameBanana browsing/discovery, profiles, launch support, patching, merging, and data-file conversion. Latest release located is v3.4.1 (2026-10-04); built-in entries include Deltarune, its demo, Undertale, and selected other GameMaker games. Windows/Linux/macOS x64 and ARM64 downloads describe the manager app, not guaranteed game compatibility. G3M operates on title-specific files/patches; it is not a runtime loader.

resources.name: Deltamod (GameMaker mod manager)
resources.summary: Community manager for packaged GameMaker mods, with patch/install workflows and backups; its ecosystem is particularly Deltarune-focused. Latest release located is v2.1.4 (2026-10-04), with Windows and Debian-based Linux packages. The release fixes include Linux patch-tool path and data-file backup handling. This is a manager/patch driver, not a runtime mod loader; verify each package against the exact game files and platform.

resources.name: DokiModManager (DDLC mod manager)
resources.summary: DDLC-specific download/install/profile manager, not a universal Ren'Py loader or a Team Salvato product. Release 1.8.0-release (2026-09-29) adds a downloads manager. Windows is the primary route; Linux is beta/RC with some mods unsupported, while the macOS alpha was reported as not working properly and is unsigned. DDLC Plus and mobile support are not listed.

resources.name: GameMaker mod.io Extension (YoYo Games)
resources.summary: Official developer extension for integrating mod.io UGC services into a GameMaker project; it is not a player-side loader and does not add mod support to already-shipped games unless their developers integrated it. Latest release located is v1.0.2 (2024-12-18), tagged for GameMaker LTS 2022; the main branch is explicitly work in progress, and current LTS 2026 compatibility is unverified despite repository build-script activity in 2026.

resources.name: DELTARUNE official Steam announcements
resources.summary: Official Steam announcement feed. Latest numbered update located at the 2026-10-06 review was Chapter 5 v0.0.253, posted 2026-07-30 for PC/Mac and PlayStation. This gives a title/store/platform patch reference, not a mod-compatibility guarantee; check chapter-specific version numbers and other platform branches separately.

resources.name: Undertale and Deltarune data-file version reference
resources.summary: Underminers Team reference table of Undertale/Deltarune data files (such as data.win, data.unx, and data.ios), reported game versions, storefront/platform variants, and checksums. Useful for matching a file before analysis; it is a community-maintained identification aid, not an installer or a promise that any mod/tool supports that build.

resources.name: Hotline Miami Steam Community FAQ: Original vs Updated
resources.summary: Pinned, community-authored Steam FAQ distinguishes Hotline Miami PC Original (GameMaker) from the Updated PC port (PhyreEngine). It is a build/engine boundary, not an official modding guide; compatibility with GOG and console editions is not documented.

resources.name: G3M GameMaker modding documentation
resources.summary: Upstream G3M documentation for the v3.4.1 manager, supported-game profiles, mod packages, and patching tools. Its DATA workflows cover formats such as g3mpatch, xdelta, data.win, game.ios, game.unx, and game.win; the docs state that filename or extension changes alone do not make platform-specific data or patches compatible.

resources.name: Team Salvato IP Guidelines (official)
resources.summary: Current official fan-content guideline page covering DDLC assets, fangames, distribution, character depictions, and generative-AI topics.

resources.name: About DDLC Plus Datamining and Modding (official)
resources.summary: Official engine/scope statement: original DDLC was made in Ren'Py, while DDLC Plus was recreated in Unity. Team Salvato expects Plus modding to be more difficult and community technical support to be more limited. This is a reference, not a modding tool.

resources.name: Doki Doki Literature Club! (official itch.io page)
resources.summary: Team Salvato's official page for the original DDLC PC release, not DDLC Plus or the mobile app. It identifies the game as Ren'Py and lists Windows/macOS/Linux as platforms; the visible downloads are Windows v1.1.1 and Mac v1.1.1, with no current Linux package established in the download list. Use the exact store package and current IP Guidelines

resources.name: Doki Doki Literature Club! (official Steam listing)
resources.summary: Official Steam listing (AppID 698780) for the original free PC game, distinct from Doki Doki Literature Club Plus. The page lists single-player and Steam Deck 'Playable'; these labels do not establish a native Linux package or mod compatibility. The Steam install/store layout differs from the Itch v1.1.1 Windows/Mac downloads; compatibility with a template or manager is not established.

resources.name: DDLC official mobile release announcement (Team Salvato)
resources.summary: Team Salvato announced a separate official iOS/Android DDLC app on 2025-12-10, developed with Serenity Forge: the core game is free, with Plus features such as Side Stories, gallery, and music available as a paid add-on. The announcement does not establish Ren'Py PC-template compatibility; treat this as a separate mobile distribution/edition.

resources.name: Doki Doki Literature Club! (official iOS listing)
resources.summary: Official Serenity Forge iPhone listing for the separate mobile app. The latest App Store version observed was 1.3.15 (2026-09-28); the listing offers Plus content as an in-app purchase. This is not the original PC v1.1.1 Ren'Py package or the PC/console DDLC Plus build, and no mod-template compatibility was verified.

resources.name: Serenity Forge statement on DDLC's Google Play removal
resources.summary: Serenity Forge's official statement says Google removed the DDLC mobile app from Google Play on 2026-04-08/09 and that the publisher was pursuing reinstatement and considering alternative Android distribution. The Play listing returned not found when checked on 2026-10-06, and no later official Android channel was located.

resources.name: r/DDLCMods community wiki megathread (discovery/reference)
resources.summary: Community resource/mod index for DDLC guides, templates, and discovery; it is not official support or a manager. Some pages contain older instructions and explicitly exclude later template revisions, so treat it as a lead only and prefer current upstream template releases and Team Salvato policy for compatibility and distribution rules.

resources.name: OneLoader (OMORI)
resources.summary: OMORI-specific runtime mod loader with mod ordering, conflict prompts, and readable session logs. Latest listed release v1.5 (2025-04-06). Its README points to a community installation wiki last edited 2022-05-26; no current store, OS, or game-build compatibility matrix was found. The documented route is desktop Steam-focused and does not establish Microsoft Store or console support.

resources.name: GOMORI (legacy OMORI mod loader)
resources.summary: Historical OMORI mod loader. The owner archived the repository on 2024-11-13 and says it is no longer supported or maintained; compatibility with many mods is unreported. Historical migration reference.

resources.name: Fear & Hunger Mod Manager / Mod Loader
resources.summary: Title-specific JavaScript mod API/loader for Fear & Hunger and Fear & Hunger 2: Termina, with mod toggles, ordering/configuration, incompatibility blocking, and separate save sets. v1.2.3 is the latest stable release located (2026-02-18); v1.2.4 (2026-04-06) is a pre-release. No exact retail build, storefront, or OS compatibility matrix was found, and upstream setup notes differ from newer release notes.

resources.name: MV Mod Loader (developer-integrated framework)
resources.summary: RPG Maker MV-only plugin framework that merges compatible mod data and exposes in-game enable/order controls. A game developer must integrate the plugin and game-specific files; it is not a universal retrofit for packaged MV games and does not target MZ. Latest repository activity located: 2024-10-02.

resources.name: RPGModder (MV/MZ mod manager)
resources.summary: External manager for packaged RPG Maker MV/MZ games. Latest release v2.0.0 (2026-07-11) uses snapshots, a transaction journal, rollback, and conflict analysis; deployment changes the live game content directory rather than virtualizing files at runtime. Native Windows x64 and Linux x64 builds support common root/www layouts, but unusual structures or runtime loaders may need game-specific rules. No named-game compatibility test was performed.

resources.summary: Official Godot 4.7 documentation for PCK/ZIP resource packs used for patches, DLC, and mods. Each game implements its own runtime pack loading; this native resource-pack feature is not a universal player-facing mod loader.

resources.summary: Community-authored Steam guide for Brotato mod developers. It describes a Godot 3/GodotSteam workflow and reports that Workshop support arrived in game v0.8; its exact engine and GodotSteam details are version-bound and are not an official or current compatibility declaration.

resources.name: Quake II rerelease game source

resources.name: Quake rerelease QuakeC source
resources.summary: Official GPLv2 QuakeC source for six codebases used by the 2021 Quake rerelease; the repository added Dawn of the Machine source on 2026-08-31. resources.name: Quake II Tools GPL source release (legacy)

resources.name: ioquake3

resources.summary: Doom-focused archive/resource and map editor for WAD/PK3 authoring and inspection; it is not a runtime loader. Upstream lists stable 3.2.12 (2026-02-21) and a newer 3.3.0 Beta 2 (2026-06-08/09); select the stable or beta line deliberately and verify target port/resource support.

resources.name: DoomTools
resources.summary: Java-based command-line utilities for Doom WAD projects, including asset/script-oriented tools such as DECOHack and build automation. The upstream master branch is active but shifts before a release is cut; this is authoring/build tooling, not a game runtime or player mod loader.

resources.name: Ultimate Doom Builder
resources.summary: Community map editor for Doom, Heretic, Hexen, and Strife-based games, with strongest support for ZDoom-family ports and configurations for classic engines. Active source changes were visible on 2026-10-06; check the current build and target map format. This is an authoring editor, not a player-side loader.

resources.name: TrenchBroom
resources.summary: Cross-platform Quake-engine map editor. Release v2026.2 (2026-08-21) and its manual document Quake III patch creation/editing, while the repository README still describes Quake III as partial and says patches/brush primitives are unsupported; treat Quake III format support as feature-specific and reconcile against the installed version. It is a map-authoring tool, not a loader.

resources.name: Doomworld /idgames archive frontend
resources.summary: Community frontend for discovering classic DOOM maps and files in the /idgames archive. The site explicitly says it is not an official /idgames mirror; it is an archive/discovery path, not a loader, compatibility test, or official rerelease upload channel.

resources.name: Quaddicted

resources.name: Quake Injector (legacy manager)

resources.name: Quake Live Steam Workshop
resources.summary: Official Steam Workshop surface for Quake Live user content, including maps and other gameplay/customization items. This is a Steam-specific distribution route for Quake Live, not a general Quake III mod API or compatibility claim for other runtimes;.

The ZIP bundles a separate DarkAgesModManager GUI; current game-patch compatibility is not established by later repository activity.

resources.name: Atlan Developer Tools (DOOM: The Dark Ages)
resources.summary: Separate authoring/research utilities for DOOM: The Dark Ages, including a limited resource/audio extractor and a mod packager; the release says players do not need these to load mods. resources.summary: Community mod browse/discovery page for Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice. It is a hosting/discovery page, not a loader or installer; per-mod target versions and requirements are user-published.
